target:
mkdir -p /srv/proof-retained /etc/caddy/orbit-websocket-cert-current; echo keep > /srv/proof-retained/user-data; printf "[Unit]
Description=Proof WebSocket removal
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/sleep infinity
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
" > /etc/systemd/system/orbit-websocket.service; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now orbit-websocket.service; ufw allow 6001/tcp comment orbit:role:websocket
